# FlareIconView

| `AriaLabel` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | Accessible label; sets aria-label + role=img. Overrides Value's label when set. |
| `Color` | `FlareColor` | `` | Parameter |  | Icon color. Overrides Value's color when not Default. |
| `Morph` | `FlareIconMorph?` | `` | Parameter |  | How a change of Value is animated. At None the swap is instant and the view renders the icon element alone, exactly as it does without this parameter; any other mode wraps the icon so the outgoing and incoming glyphs can share one box while they trade places. The first value to arrive never animates - there is nothing for it to replace. |
|  |  |  |  |  | Left unset, the mode is inherited from the enclosing scope - FlareThemeProvider.IconMorph, or any CascadingValue of this type - so an app turns icon transitions on for the whole library, its own chrome included, without touching call sites. Setting it here overrides that either way, including back to None. |
| `Size` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | Icon size as any CSS length (e.g. "3rem"). Overrides Value's size when set. |
| `SizePx` | `int?` | `` | Parameter |  | Convenience pixel size (e.g. 48 -> "48px"). Ignored when Size is set. |
| `Value` | `FlareIcon?` | `` | Parameter |  | The icon descriptor to render - any provider (FlareSvgIcon, or an add-on pack type). Icons are values: build one directly (FlareIcons.Home, MaterialDesign3Icons.Regular.Home, new FlareSvgIcon { Data = "..." }). There is no lookup by icon name - that is what keeps the SVG icon packages trimmable (only the icons you reference statically are published). |
